title: Full-Time Job, Two Kids... Now It's $4K/Month
excerpt: Mallorie Rauch, a physician assistant with two kids and a full-time job, joined Vendingpreneurs and turned two storage-bound machines into a $4K/month route.
quote: The first thing is, when everybody tells me 'I don't have time for this,' I'm like, 'Call me. Let me tell you about time.'
body:
## Background
Mallorie Rauch and her husband are both licensed physician assistants working full-time in healthcare. Between two young kids, two rental properties, and three per-diem jobs, she'd wanted to build something of her own for years — partly so her kids could watch her build a business and learn entrepreneurship isn't only a traditional path. She joined Vendingpreneurs in March 2025.

> "I think we suffer from analysis paralysis... we were actually looking at doing something outside of our regular jobs for about 10 years."

## The Challenge
Real estate and business acquisition both demanded large down payments and real risk — their two rental properties alone required $152,000 and $260,000 with 20 to 25% down. In October 2024 she and her husband bought two vending machines off Facebook Marketplace and had no idea what to do with them; the machines just sat in storage.

> "I'm putting in machines that are anywhere from 3 to 5,000, and I'm like, if this doesn't work out, that's fine — we're going to be okay. Versus if this house collapses and catches fire and our insurance is screwed, we're out a lot of money."

## The Turning Point
Joining Vendingpreneurs finally gave them a process and a marketing flyer, and got their machines out of storage.

> "March of 2025 we joined Vendingpreneurs — game changer... finally we get a marketing flyer, and within 10 days we land our first location, and we're able to get these machines out of storage."

## Where They Are Now
They now run six locations generating roughly $4,000 a month. Their top location, a boat-captain school, brings in $1,700 a month; a gym location selling wholesale protein powder and creatine earns $15 to $25 margin per transaction. Next month they're installing three machines at a law office with 500 employees on site daily. Their kids now help pick orders at night, and their five-year-old recently told Mallorie the thing she was proudest of that day was helping her parents with their business.

> "There is a point in time where you just start to realize that your time is worth much more than what they're willing to offer in a W2 position."
